account.description: Account nickname (e.g., 'work'). Optional if only one account connected.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

fields.description: Optional array of additional event fields to retrieve. Available fields are strictly validated. Default fields (id, summary, start, end, status, htmlLink, location, attendees) are always included.

account.description: Account nickname (e.g., 'work'). Optional if only one account connected.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

eventId.description: Optional custom event ID (5-1024 characters, base32hex encoding: lowercase letters a-v and digits 0-9 only). If not provided, Google Calendar will generate one.

start.description: Event start time. String format: '2025-01-01T10:00:00' (timed) or '2025-01-01' (all-day). For per-field timezone, use JSON: '{"dateTime": "2025-01-01T10:00:00", "timeZone": "America/Los_Angeles"}'. Per-field timezone is useful for events spanning multiple timezones (e.g., flights). Note: If the dateTime already includes a timezone offset (e.g., 'Z' or '+05:00'), the embedded timezone takes precedence over the timeZone field.

end.description: Event end time. String format: '2025-01-01T11:00:00' (timed) or '2025-01-02' (all-day, exclusive). For per-field timezone, use JSON: '{"dateTime": "2025-01-01T11:00:00", "timeZone": "America/New_York"}'. Per-field timezone is useful for events spanning multiple timezones (e.g., flights). Note: If the dateTime already includes a timezone offset (e.g., 'Z' or '+05:00'), the embedded timezone takes precedence over the timeZone field.

timeZone.description: Timezone as IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., America/Los_Angeles). Takes priority over calendar's default timezone. Only used for timezone-naive datetime strings.

attendees.description: List of event attendees with their details

optional.description: Whether this is an optional attendee

additionalGuests.description: Number of additional guests the attendee is bringing

colorId.description: Color ID for the event (use list-colors to see available IDs)

useDefault.description: Whether to use the default reminders

minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger the reminder

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar. 'opaque' means busy, 'transparent' means free.

visibility.description: Visibility of the event. Use 'public' for public events, 'private' for private events visible to attendees.

guestsCanInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees can invite others to the event. Default is true.

guestsCanModify.description: Whether attendees can modify the event. Default is false.

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees can see the list of other attendees. Default is true.

anyoneCanAddSelf.description: Whether anyone can add themselves to the event. Default is false.

sendUpdates.description: Whether to send notifications about the event creation. 'all' sends to all guests, 'externalOnly' to non-Google Calendar users only, 'none' sends no notifications.

conferenceData.description: Conference properties for the event. Use createRequest to add a new conference.

requestId.description: Client-generated unique ID for this request to ensure idempotency

createRequest.description: Request to generate a new conference

extendedProperties.description: Extended properties for storing application-specific data. Max 300 properties totaling 32KB.

private.description: Properties private to the application. Keys can have max 44 chars, values max 1024 chars.

shared.description: Properties visible to all attendees. Keys can have max 44 chars, values max 1024 chars.

attachments.description: File attachments for the event. Requires calendar to support attachments.

iconLink.description: URL of the icon for the attachment

fileId.description: ID of the attached file in Google Drive

source.description: Source of the event, such as a web page or email message.

calendarsToCheck.description: List of calendar IDs to check for conflicts (defaults to just the target calendar)

duplicateSimilarityThreshold.description: Threshold for duplicate detection (0-1, default: 0.7). Events with similarity above this are flagged as potential duplicates

allowDuplicates.description: If true, allows creation even when exact duplicates are detected (similarity >= 0.95). Default is false which blocks duplicate creation

eventType.description: Type of the event. 'default' for regular events, 'focusTime' for Focus Time blocks, 'outOfOffice' for Out of Office events, 'workingLocation' for Working Location events. Note: outOfOffice and workingLocation require Google Workspace and only work on primary calendar.

focusTimeProperties.description: Focus Time properties. Only used when eventType is 'focusTime'. Requires Google Workspace.

outOfOfficeProperties.description: Out of Office properties. Only used when eventType is 'outOfOffice'. Requires Google Workspace.

autoDeclineMode.description: How to handle conflicting meetings. Default is to decline all conflicts.

declineMessage.description: Message sent when declining invitations (e.g., 'I'm out of office, will respond when I return')

workingLocationProperties.description: Working Location properties. Only used when eventType is 'workingLocation'. Requires Google Workspace.

homeOffice.description: Empty object for home office type

label.description: Office name shown in Calendar (e.g., 'HQ Building', 'NYC Office')
